name: Bahrain International Circuit
description: Bahrain International Circuit in the desert. Big stops into slow corners, a rough surface that wears tyres, and sand blown onto the track. Often raced into the night.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1287 of 2164 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
